newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Christmas crash kills 17, hurts 12 in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Christmas crash kills 17, hurts 12 in Philippines.

text.p: Seventeen persons rushing home to celebrate Christmas were burned to death when the minibus they were travelling in crashed and caught fire in the southern Philippines, police said on Thursday.

Twelve other passengers were hurt when the the driver of the overloaded vehicle lost control while negotiating a steep descent between the towns of Tipo-tipo and Maluso in southern Basilan province on Wednesday, police said.
Police said they found remnants of plastic petrol containers in the burned-out bus, which were possibly being transported by one of the passengers.
The delay in reporting the incident was blamed on poor communications from the area. Police said it was the worst vehicular accident in Basilan this year.
